note: The tagged interest_rate sits in this column's cells and matches n1 on nearly every row. In the 'incl. PIK' shapes n1 equals the tagged interest_rate and n2 equals pik_rate, so n1 is the all-in rate and n2 the PIK part. The '#% PIK' shape (1 row) is tagged interest_rate and also matches pik_rate, so the number is treated as PIK-only, though it may be the all-in rate on a fully PIK loan.
